events.title: Anthropic and Accenture create an embedded frontier-evaluation model
events.title_zh: Anthropic 与 Accenture 建立嵌入式前沿模型评估机制
events.summary: Anthropic and Accenture will embed Faculty evaluators inside Anthropic with access comparable to employees. The work will cover model evaluation, red teaming, alignment assessments and safeguard tests informed by enterprise deployments. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years. The operating model, publication rules and conflict safeguards are still being designed.
events.why_it_matters: For model buyers and safety teams, this is a concrete move from occasional external tests toward continuous third-party access inside a frontier lab. The arrangement is not yet proof of independent oversight: its value will depend on evaluator autonomy, what results become public and whether findings can block deployment.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 与 Accenture 将让 Faculty 的评估人员嵌入 Anthropic，获得接近内部员工的访问权限。工作范围包括模型评测、红队、alignment assessment 与护栏测试，并引入 Accenture 的企业部署经验。双方预计未来 5 年各投入至少 10 亿美元，但具体运行方式、披露规则和利益冲突防护仍在设计。

events.title: SGLang 0.5.20 adds branch-aware caching and replayable RL sampling
events.title_zh: SGLang 0.5.20 加入分支缓存与可回放 RL 采样
events.summary: SGLang 0.5.20 ships exact sampling masks for reproducible RL rollouts, a unified radix tree that preserves sliding-window state at branch points, and a CPU-only simulator that runs the real scheduler and cache logic. On a DeepSeek-V4-Flash shared-prefix test, the new cache raised token hits from 43.8% to 60.8% and cut mean TTFT from 1.57 to 1.07 seconds. The release also makes Responses API storage opt-in and adds production support for several new hybrid and diffusion models.
events.why_it_matters: For inference and post-training teams, one release improves three hard operational surfaces: replayable sampling, branch-heavy prefix reuse and capacity planning without GPUs. Upgrade tests should cover the breaking Responses storage default and removed legacy prefill context-parallel path before production rollout.
events.summary_zh: SGLang 0.5.20 新增可精确回放 RL rollout 的 sampling mask、在分支点保留滑动窗口状态的统一 radix tree，以及运行真实 scheduler 与缓存逻辑的 CPU-only simulator。在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 共享前缀测试中，新缓存把 token 命中率从 43.8% 提高到 60.8%，平均首 token 延迟从 1.57 秒降到 1.07 秒。Responses API 的结果存储改为显式开启，并新增多种混合与 diffusion 模型的生产支持。

On a DeepSeek-V4-Flash shared-prefix test, the new cache raised token hits from 43.8% to 60.8% and cut mean TTFT from 1.57 to 1.07 seconds. The release also makes Responses API storage opt-in and adds production support for several new hybrid and diffusion models.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对推理与 post-training 团队来说，这一个版本同时改善三类难题：可回放采样、分支密集型前缀复用，以及不占 GPU 的容量规划。上线前要重点测试 Responses 存储默认值变化，以及旧 prefill context parallel 路径被移除带来的兼容性。

events.title: SpaceXAI halves transcription error without raising API prices
events.title_zh: SpaceXAI 将转写错误率减半且不涨 API 价格
events.summary: SpaceXAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 for batch and streaming speech-to-text. Artificial Analysis reports a 2.3% word error rate on its public index versus 4.0% for version 1.0, while the API price remains $0.10 per audio hour for batch and $0.20 for streaming. The model adds word confidence, diarization, eight-channel transcription, key-term biasing and automatic language switching, and is already used for every Atlassian Loom video.
events.why_it_matters: For voice-agent and media pipelines, this is a material quality gain at a price low enough to change build-versus-buy calculations. Trial it on noisy domain audio and proper nouns before switching defaults; public aggregate accuracy does not replace workload-specific error, latency and privacy testing.
events.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 发布 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，支持批量与流式语音转文字。Artificial Analysis 的公开榜单给出 2.3% 词错误率，上一代为 4.0%；API 价格仍是批量每音频小时 0.10 美元、流式 0.20 美元。模型还提供逐词置信度、说话人分离、最多 8 声道转写、关键词偏置与录音内自动切换语言，并已用于 Atlassian Loom 的全部视频。

The model adds word confidence, diarization, eight-channel transcription, key-term biasing and automatic language switching, and is already used for every Atlassian Loom video.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对语音 agent 和媒体流水线来说，这是足以影响自建还是采购判断的质量提升，而且价格很低。切换默认模型前，应先用嘈杂的真实业务录音和专有名词做试验；公开综合准确率不能替代本业务的错误率、延迟与隐私测试。

events.title: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate adds speakers and context to real-time interpreting
events.title_zh: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate 为实时同传补上说话人与上下文
events.summary: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate upgrades real-time interpreting with speaker separation, bilingual source-and-translation output and long-context disambiguation. Qwen reports average lag falling from 2.8 to 2.3 seconds while retaining 60 input languages; the API produces speech in 29 languages through a 53,248-token context window. The production model is available over Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's WebSocket Realtime API in Beijing and Singapore.
events.why_it_matters: For multilingual meetings, support and live events, speaker identity and terminology consistency often matter more than another small generic translation gain. Trial it with overlapping speakers and domain vocabulary, but compare end-to-end latency and translation quality independently because the headline quality claims are vendor-reported.
events.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate 为实时同传加入说话人分离、双语原文与译文同步输出，以及利用长上下文消歧。Qwen 称平均延迟从 2.8 秒降到 2.3 秒，同时保留 60 种输入语言；API 可用 29 种语言输出语音，上下文窗口为 53,248 token。正式模型已通过阿里云百炼的 WebSocket Realtime API 在北京与新加坡提供。
events.summary_en: Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate upgrades real-time interpreting with speaker separation, bilingual source-and-translation output and long-context disambiguation. Qwen reports average lag falling from 2.8 to 2.3 seconds while retaining 60 input languages; the API produces speech in 29 languages through a 53,248-token context window. The production model is available over Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's WebSocket Realtime API in Beijing and Singapore.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多语言会议、客服和直播活动来说，说话人身份与术语一致性往往比通用翻译分数的小幅提升更重要。建议用多人重叠发言和领域词汇试跑，并独立比较端到端延迟与翻译质量，因为核心质量指标仍来自厂商。
